retentionWindow.description:
Time threshold for snapshot expiration. Combined with 'end' gives an interval for which snapshots outside of will be expired.
Only intervals up to millisecond precision are supported.

Examples: '30d' (30 days), '1m' (1 month)

end.description: Provide a reference for the 'retentionWindow'. Default is now.

minimumSnapshots.description:
Minimum number of snapshots to retain. At least this many snapshots will be kept, regardless of retentionWindow. However:
1. Expiry may keep more than minimumSnapshots ancestors if snapshots are added concurrently.
2. Expiry may keep less than minimumSnapshots ancestors if the current table state does not have that many.

Must be greater than zero if specified.

title: Configuration of snapshot expiration policies for Iceberg tables.
name: DataLake.Table.ExpireSnapshotSpec
